title: Multiple Iterative Labeling by Antibody Neodeposition (MILAN)
protocol: Use standard 75.5±0.5 mm x 25.5±0.5 mm microscope slides for histopathology studies.
Place sections of 3±1 µm thickness on positively charged slides, one section per slide.
Position the sections toward the slide end opposite to the frosted end, at least 2-3 mm from the slide border.
Bake the slides overnight in an upright position in an oven at 40°C or lower.
Dewax the sections in Xylene (two changes for 10 minutes each).
Proceed with graded alcohol treatment (99%, 95%, 70%, H2O).
Consider an optional Hexane overnight step before dewaxing for complete paraffin extraction.
Dilute all primary Ab’s to 1 µg/ml in Antibody diluent.
Dilute all secondary Ab’s to 5 µg/ml in Antibody diluent.
Perform antigen retrieval with 10 mM EDTA in Tris-buffer, pH 8.
Use 8 ml of a 100x Tris-EDTA buffer in 800 ml distilled water.
Boil slides for 8 min at high power (850W) in a microwave oven.
Reduce power to low and boil intermittently for 20-30 minutes.
Cool slides to 50°C or below before transferring to washing buffer.
Slides can be stored in 50% glycerol-sucrose-TBS.
Check the humid chamber for perfectly horizontal placement using a level or iPhone to prevent antibody solution from slipping during prolonged incubations.
Do not let the slides touch each other.
Use a closed container with distilled water, Sodium Azide, and a tissue to prevent floating.
Use a minimum of 100 µl of antibody for a section of 1x1 cm or less, and multiply the volume accordingly for larger sections.
Fill a standard 5 slide vertical mailer with 12 ml of antibody solution.
Incubate slides in primary Ab overnight at room temperature manually or at +4°C using mailers.
Wash twice in TBS-Ts for 15 minutes each in a Coplin jar.
Incubate in secondary antibody for 30 minutes.
Wash twice in TBS-Ts for 15 minutes each in a Coplin jar.
Incubate in negative primary antibody.
Wash twice in TBS-Ts for 15 minutes each in a Coplin jar.
Incubate in secondary antibody for 30 minutes.
Stain with DAPI (2-10 nM) by immersing the sample in TBS-Ts for 1 minute, then rinse in TBS-Ts.
Mount slides using mounting fluid and cover slips.
Remove excess fluid from edges of mounted slides.
Remove disaccharide-containing fluid from slide bottom with a pad soaked in distilled water.
Affix a label containing a 2D barcode with metadata including date, experiment number, etc.
Soak the coverslip off in a Coplin jar filled with washing buffer or distilled water.
Transfer tissue sections to Tris buffer pH 7.5 to remove disaccharides.
Preheat vertical containers with stripping buffer to exactly 56°C in a closed, shaking water-bath.
Strip for 30 min at 56°C with shaking.
Transfer to TBS-Ts after stripping.
Wash slides thoroughly with washing buffer, performing multiple washes within the first quarter of an hour.
